`final class UICharEvent<U extends UI>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`UIInputEvent<U>`](/reference/events/uiinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UICharEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/ui/UICharEvent.java)

The event of `handleCharTyped` on a UI, with one typed character that no node consumed, as a Unicode code point.

## Description

The character comes with the layout and the Shift key applied; control characters never arrive.

- [Keyboard](/use/learn/interactivity/keyboard/#react-to-a-key)
